description: The hypotheses moved in MML's favour, within what the chapters argue rather than beyond it: a vehicle designed to last, slow later-life consumption, infrastructure-grade capital, fuel back at its 2025 level.

vehicles.toyota-corolla-ts-hybrid.lifecy.rationale: optimistic: an mml-adapted model line with scheduled refurbishment reaching the life chapter 3 argues for

finance.firstLifeConsumptionFactor.rationale: optimistic: first-life consumption close to the average

finance.laterLifeConsumptionFactor.rationale: optimistic: later lives consume the asset markedly more slowly

finance.fleetCostOfCapital.rationale: optimistic: asset-company funding at infrastructure cost

energy.petrolPerLitre.rationale: optimistic: petrol back at the 2025 national average

energy.realUseUplift.rationale: optimistic: real-use gap at the bottom of the range for full hybrids

insurance.fleetDiscount.rationale: optimistic: a lifecycle fleet with repair-before-replacement earns a deeper pooling discount
